description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NotAllowedException' within the SuiteCRM project. It extends a base 'Exception' class and is used to signal unauthorized or disallowed operations, with an error message prefixed by '[Not Allowed]'. The class constructor accepts optional message, code, and previous exception parameters.

classes.name: NotAllowedException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate 'not allowed' or unauthorized actions within SuiteCRM, extending the base 'Exception' class and prepending a specific message prefix.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of 'NotAllowedException', calling the parent constructor with a '[Not Allowed]' prefixed message and optional code and previous exception.
